target_customer: Engineering and security teams at companies shipping code fast with AI coding tools
problem: Code is produced faster than security teams can review, so vulnerabilities in code, CI and cloud go untriaged.
business_model: B2B security platform with AI agents for pentesting, internal discovery and remediation; pricing by contact

founders.name: Pierre Betouin
founders.background_notes: Led security products at Datadog after the Sqreen acquisition and spent nine years at Apple on security assessments per YC page.

founders.name: Vladimir de Turckheim
founders.background_notes: Staff engineer on security products at Datadog, joined via Sqreen as employee 4; Node.js core collaborator for five years per YC page.

founders.name: Jean-Baptiste Aviat
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder in YC launch post and Accel; background not found in pages opened.

founders.name: Arnaud Breton
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder in YC launch post; background not found in pages opened.

competitors.name: RunSybil
competitors.traction_then: Listed as closest match on a directory

technical_complexity.rationale: Building a live production knowledge graph across cloud, containers and vendors and agents that safely verify and remediate issues is hard, mitigated by founders' deep security product experience.

defensibility.rationale: Integration with customers' stacks and a knowledge graph build stickiness, but many AI security startups and incumbents pursue the same idea.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Unknown. Consolidation was active, for example Checkmarx buying Tromzo in December 2025 and OpenAI buying Promptfoo in March 2026.

market_need_then: AI coding tools sharply raised code volume in 2025 and 2026, and security vendors were acquiring AI security startups, indicating demand for faster triage.

identity.visual_style: Product pages with three named agents
identity.voice_and_tone: Punchy: Secure at the pace of ClaudeCodexAI; AI writes the code, Tolmo secures it

branding.brand_signature: AI writes the code. Tolmo secures it.

brand_strength.rationale: A short, ownable name on an exact .com with a memorable tagline, backed by Accel launch coverage, but little independent press on the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Tolmo is active and raised a $22M seed led by Accel in June 2026 after the founders left security roles at Datadog following the Sqreen acquisition. Strong founder market fit and the AI code volume tailwind support it, while many AI security rivals and acquirers make the field crowded. No later events are reported.
notes: Seed of $22M confirmed by Accel's own page listing and Seedtable and Nordic9, but only snippets of those pages were seen. Investor list beyond Accel and YC comes from Nordic9 and Dealroom snippets. Dealroom shows an $88M valuation (unconfirmed, not recorded) and a separate $125K YC seed in March 2026 (not recorded as a round, YC standard deal). Announcement date varies (June 18 versus a May 20 article date). Founder education not on YC page.
